content: We took the kids to see Kendrick and Sza at SoFi Stadium on Friday, May 23. It was a great show, but the sound was absolutely awful. You would think in a venue as new as SoFi is, they would have worked out all the acoustics. The kids didn’t care though. Their minds were blown and that’s all that mattered. Getting to see two artists at the top of their game was really special. I’m grateful we could give that to them.
